tickets.title: Interactive Form Controls
tickets.description: Styles an input field and button that react smoothly to user focus and hover interactions.
tasks: Styles an input field and button that react smoothly to user focus and hover interactions.
learning_objectives: Build pixel-perfect UI without custom CSS.
tickets.evaluation: `check_class_used("focus:ring-2")` `check_class_used("hover:bg-indigo-700")` `check_class_used("transition-colors")` **[A] Visual (40 pts)**: 40 pts if the focus ring activates cleanly without layout shift. **[B] Logic (40 pts)**: 40 pts for implementing `focus:`, `hover:`, and `active:` variants. **[C] Quality (10 pts)**: 10 pts for adding `transition` classes for smooth state changes.
common_mistakes: Using inline styles or a custom stylesheet instead of composing utility classes.
hints: Don't write custom CSS. Check the Tailwind documentation for the correct utility class.
